tvShows.name: Naagin
tvShows.description: She is back in a new avatar! She will stop the corrupt to protect the nation and exact vengeance. Watch Naagin - Hindi Fantasy Drama Mystery Family serial on JioHotstar now.

episodes.duration: Rithik's engagement at the Haveli faces unexpected obstacles. Meanwhile, the Naagins, Sesha and Shivanya, are finally free to take any form after 20 years.
episodes.episodeName: The Naagin begins with her revenge plan

episodes.duration: Sesha reaches the mansion disguised as a dancer and mixes poison in the drinks but no one is harmed. Yamini finds Sesha turning into a snake.
Tanvi and Hrithik's engagement is underway when Shivanya re-enters Hrithik's house with the help of Sesha. She intends to avenge her parent's death.
Shivanya confronts Viren's advances at the Raheja house.  Ritwik rescues her from Viren's blackmail, leading to a blossoming romance between Shivanya and Ritwik.
episodes.episodeName: Viren's attempts to get intimate with Shivanya

episodes.duration: Ankush and Yamini find a shocking poster and hide it. Hrithik claims he's marrying Tanvi for her happiness but Yamini reveals the truth about his horoscope.
Shivanya's bite thwarts Tanvi's wedding. Yamini's stunned reaction to Shivanya as the bride ignites Shivanya's revenge, forcing Yamini to accept her marriage to Rithik.
Hritik's mother arranges his marriage to Shivanya, who saved his life, instead of his beloved Tanvi. Hritik, despite his love for Shivanya, offers her freedom.
A servant's discovery of a snake skin near the temple prompts the priest to burn it, hoping to draw the snake out. Sesha fears for Shivanya's safety and prays for her protection.
Shivanya suspects Suri in her parents' death, noticing his six fingers. But Shesha, impatient, plans to kill him at the airport.
Tanvi tells her parents that she heard Shivanya talk about revenge. Later, as Sushim informs Ankush about the Naagin's return. Shesha and Shivanya overhear their conversation.
Shivanya takes the form of an astrologer named Ramya and warns the killers. Later, Sesha takes the form of Monisha and tricks Sailesh into seducing the real Monisha.
episodes.episodeName: Naagin ploys killers against each other

episodes.duration: Rithik reveals his love for Shivanya, but Tanvi questions her. Guruma uses magic against Sesha, who plots Suri's death in the temple.
Suri's shock: Shivanya's at the temple! Guruma orders a 'Mahakali Puja' to expel the 'naagin', forcing Shivanya and Rithik to participate.
episodes.episodeName: Will Shivanya attend the Mahakali puja?

episodes.duration: Shivanya saves Ritik from the poison given by Sesha. Later, Sesha prays for a storm which endangers Ankush's and his family's life.
Shivanya persuades Goddess Kali to side with the innocent snakes. Shivanya and Ritik go to the old Haveli; Sesha disrupts Guruma's prayers and bites her.
Shivanya and Ritik face strange happenings at the old mansion. Guruma traps Sesha in the cave. Back home, Yamini and Ankush confront them.
Guruma traps Sesha. Shivanya, bitten by a snake, begs Rithik to take her to Gurumaa.  While Rithik and Gurumaa seek herbs, Shivanya rescues Sesha from the cave.
episodes.episodeName: Sesha and Shivanya wins yet again.

episodes.duration: Shivanya's secret visit to the Naagin temple is discovered by Yamini. Shesha steps in to save the day by switching lockets. Meanwhile, Kabir arrives at Ankush's to see Thanvi.
Sesha, disguised as Ankur, steals Sailesh's ring at the Kya Kool Hain Hum-3 premiere. She lures him to Shiv Mandir, setting the stage for a deadly plot with Shivanya.
episodes.episodeName: Sesha plans to kill Sailesh Mathur

episodes.duration: Tanvi sees Shivanya and Shesha transforming into serpents. Kabir transforms into a big Mongoose in front of Tanvi and kills her. The fake Kabir kills the real Kabir.
Rithik grieves over Tanvi's death. Kabir tries to kill Shivanya but Gurudev saves her. Sesha and Shivanya want to find the mongoose. Kabir traps Sesha.
Rithik tells Shivanya that he saw a dream about a diamond. Shivanya takes Kabir's watch to Guruji. A masked man comes and kills Suri's wife.
Monisha is shot by a stranger. Shesha suspects Rithvik, but the truth is revealed - Ankush is the killer.  Nagapanchami rituals unfold in Ankush's house.
Shivanya, poisoned by a dagger, fights for survival as Gurudev attempts a cure. Sesha, her transformed clone, discovers a mark on Ritik that echoes a legend in the book "Naagmani."
Guruma's failed attacks leave the Naagin vulnerable. She races to the Rahejas for help, while Gurudev unveils the Naagmani's power to revive Shivanya.
Shivanya reunites with a Sesha-controlled Ritik. Rejecting his enchanted love, she forces him away, defying Remya's accusations of being a Naagin, confirmed false by Guruma.
Katak and Sesha restore Shivanya's powers through ancient rituals. Lord Krishna intervenes, granting her strength. She exacts revenge on Shailesh and his men.
Shivanya's resurrected powers claim Shailesh's life. Traumatized Ritik alerts the family, leaving them shocked. Sesha aids Shivanya in retrieving the Mang Tika.
episodes.episodeName: Ritik witnesses the killing of Shailesh

episodes.duration: Shivanya dances to awaken the naagmani, while Sesha fights to keep Ritik and Guruma away. Ankush seeks the naagmani, but the Naagins stand guard.
Yamini's attempt to steal the Nagmani from the cave fails as the auspicious time passes. She postpones her plan. Meanwhile, Shivanya rescues an unconscious Ritik from the temple.
Sangram Singh, after running away from the cave, decides to find his son at any cost. Later, he reveals that he never expected his sister Yamini to betray him and wreck his life.
episodes.episodeName: SANGRAM SINGH ESCAPES FROM THE CAVE

episodes.duration: Manipulated by Yamini, Rithik seeks the serpent's gem, while Sesha and Shivanya try to stop him. But Yamini's betrayal sends Maharaj Sangram Singh to his death.
Shivanya hunts her parents' killer, but the Naag mani yields no clues. Ankush attacks Ritik, thwarted by Shivanya. Sesha finds Ritik's father and the Naag mani missing.
Guruma introduces Mayuri, her new assistant, to lure Ritik. Meanwhile, Sesha investigates the Naagmani, following in her father's footsteps.
Mayuri reveals Shesha's true form to Yamini, using a mirror and her powers.  Later, she mysteriously injures Shivanya to further expose her identity.
Shesha confronts Mayuri for secretly attacking Shivanya and tries to kill her. However, Mayuri defeats Shesha in the fight and holds her captive in an attempt to seize the nagmani.
episodes.episodeName: The duel between Shesha and Mayuri

episodes.duration: Sangram Singh reads an ancient book and learns that Mahishmati race is on its way to destroy the human race. Meanwhile when Mayuri captures Shesha, she gets killed by Shivanya.
episodes.episodeName: Mahishmati race to destroy human race

episodes.duration: Yamini's treachery is exposed when Ritik (Shesha) attacks Sangram. Shivanya, as Sangram, confronts Yamini, demanding the fifth killer's name. Yamini retaliates with accusations.
Sesha joins Shivanya's fight against the Aghoris, but gets trapped. Ritik arrives with the police, saving them and the other serpents.
Yamini manipulates Ankush to get a Naagin killed. Her tears and cunning scheme turn Shivanya against Ankush. Will they see through her deceit?
Shivanya's heartbreak deepens as Sesha nearly marries Ritik, but Ankush's arrest and Yamini's temple discovery of an unconscious Guru Maa disrupt the chaos. Sangram foresees doom.
Shivanya chases Yamini, thief of the powerful Naagmani, into a cavern. Will Shivanya stop Yamini before she claims ultimate power?
Sesha and Yamini combine forces to attain the Nagmani. Later, they attempt to kill Shivanya and stop her from being a hurdle. Will they succeed in incapacitating her?
Shivanya, posing as Sesha, tries to seduce Ritik, but her secret's out. Fleeing Guru Maa, she must reveal a shocking truth about his parents. Will he believe her?
Ritik's world shatters when Yamini exposes Shivanya's secret. Sesha attacks, and Yamini tricks Ritik into killing Shivanya to save their family. Can love survive?
Yamini murders Shivanya, then throws Ritik into the sea. Resurrected by the shivling, Shivanya rescues Ritik. Can she find the Nagamani to save him?
Shivanya uses the Naagmani to save Ritik and reunite him with his father. Sesha's freedom comes at Guru Dev's cost. Yamini's evil catches up to her.
Yamini, armed and ready, hears of Ritik's return. But Ritik's fate is tied to protecting the Naagamani, not becoming a Naag. Will Shivanya finally find justice?
Guru Maa's dark magic summons a deadly tornado, trapping Ritik and Shivanya in ice. Ritik's rescue leads to intimacy, but at what cost?
Sesha's theft of the Naagmani is thwarted by Shivanya, only for Sangram (under Guru Maa's control) to steal it. A gunfight leaves Sangram wounded.
Bee-stung Sangram seeks revenge on Ritik, turning evil. Meanwhile, Kabir returns to fight the Naagins, allying with Sesha. Their shared hatred masks deeper, personal vendettas.
Sesha, disguised as Remya, leads Shivanya to her room. Kabir, lured by Sesha, enters to kill Shivanya. Will Ritik save her?
episodes.episodeName: Shivanya comes face to face with Kabir

episodes.duration: Yamini finds Ritik faked-imprisoned by a Naagin. He escapes to save Shivanya, leading to a showdown with Viren and the police, ending in Viren's shooting.
A deadly attack by Sesha turns Shivanya into a snake. Kabir, a mongoose, fights Sesha, then kidnaps Ritik. Shivanya must make a dangerous deal with Sesha for Ritik's rescue.
Shivanya and Sesha defeat Kabir, freeing Ritik. But Yamini and Sesha plot to reignite the ancient Chandravanshi-Suryavanshi feud. Can Shivanya stop them?
Shivanya and Ritik's ritual to summon Kali Maa is interrupted by Yamini's attack. But Shivanya gains the goddess's power. Will Yamini face the wrath of Kali Maa?
Ritik and Shivanya face their ultimate challenge as Queen Avantika and Sesha join forces against them, threatening to steal the Naagmani.
episodes.episodeName: The battle for the Naagmani reaches fever pitch

episodes.duration: Mother protects daughter from a dark heritage. Fate intervenes on Kal Ratri.
Aditya, Shivangi, Ruchika, and Rocky collide at a club. Rocky ends his engagement; Shivanya convinces Shivangi to marry Aditya.
episodes.episodeName: Will Shivangi and Ruchika cross paths?

episodes.duration: Love confession, a fight, and a murder plot. Will Shivangi and Rocky survive Yamini and Sesha's deadly plan?
episodes.episodeName: Shivangi confesses her love for Rocky

episodes.duration: Shooting! Shivangi recovers. Home invasion fuels Shivanya's urgency. Yamini's wedding announcement enrages Ruchika, who seeks revenge.
episodes.episodeName: Shivanya urges Shivangi to get married to Rocky

episodes.duration: 25 years later, revenge is plotted against Shivanya & Shivangi. A wedding becomes a deadly trap; Shivanya is stabbed.
Dream or not, Shivanya's family dies. Sesha and Yamini capture Shivangi after stabbing Shivanya. Her fate?
episodes.episodeName: Tragic: The wedding turns into a bloodbath!

episodes.duration: Shivangi avenges her mother's death, believing Rocky played a part. Their love faces its ultimate test.
episodes.episodeName: Shivangi vows to avenge Shivanya's killers!

episodes.duration: Yamini plots, Shivangi discovers her destiny as a Naagin, and a shocking photo reveals a family secret at her father's haveli.
Seeking the Naagmani, three women fail. Shivangi, fearing its fall into the wrong hands, takes drastic action. Her fate?
Naagin Shivangi avenges her mother's murder. She marries Rocky, concealing her identity to destroy her foes and protect the Naagmani.
Fueled by revenge, Shivangi unleashes her power after her mother's death. Yamini plots with Ruchika for the Naagmani. Will Ruchika survive Shivangi's wrath?
Amar is murdered, Ruchika's framed. She escapes, kills the commissioner. A watching man becomes her lawyer ‚Äì what's his game?
Revenge fuels Shivangi & the Naag's plot against Ruchika, Yamini, & Mahismati. A haveli showdown decides their fate.
Shivangi faces a deadly scorpion test after Yamini links her to a Naagin's killing spree.
episodes.episodeName: Yamini threatens to expose Shivangi's identity!
Shivangi has the venom to kill Rani Avantika

episodes.duration: Sacred pendant protects Mahishmati from unknown attackers. Shivangi's challenge: kill Vikram, now unprotected.
Vikram's killer, Shivangi, witnesses Rudra's death after the Naagjalmani ritual. She hunts a second murderer.
episodes.episodeName: Rudra is killed by the Mahishmatis

episodes.duration: Rudra's death spurs Shivangi's quest for a magical cure. She defeats the scorpion king. A new enemy, Ahkilesh, emerges.
episodes.episodeName: Shivangi brings Rudra back to life

episodes.duration: Akhilesh's murder plot exposed! Shivangi manipulates Yamini to destroy him, avenging her father.
episodes.episodeName: Shivangi creates a rift between Yamini and Akhilesh

episodes.duration: Misunderstanding between Shivangi & Rudra. Sesha manipulates, Akhilesh's 'kawach' exposed to Yamini.
Shivangi's naagin secret is exposed by a hawk. Yamini and Kapalika confront her. Can Shivangi overcome this crisis?
Family discovers Rudra's deceit. Shivangi's weakness exposed; Ruchika has her 'kechuli'. Will she strike?
Shivangi's plan and Rudra's naag form battle Yamini for the Nagamani. Victory hangs in the balance.
Naagmani hunt! Only a Suryavanshi can locate it using a ritual. Yamini tricks Shivangi, who's lost while searching for Rudra.
episodes.episodeName: Shivangi in a fix in her search for Rudra

episodes.duration: Naagmani hunt fails, Rudra's rescued. Mahish demands a horn, another serpent revealed. Ruchika targets Shivangi. Blood will be shed.
episodes.episodeName: So close, yet so far- Yamini loses the Naagmani!

episodes.duration: Overhearing a secret, Shivangi confronts Rocky at the Shiv Mandir. Will she kill him, or find redemption?
Seeking revenge, Shivangi battles Kapalika. Rocky unknowingly helps, leading to Kapalika's demise. Shivangi's mother is avenged.
To save her injured husband, Shivangi must sacrifice her sacred duty as Naagmani protector ‚Äì or lose him.
episodes.episodeName: Shivangi in dilemma over Rocky's accident

episodes.duration: Betrayed, Akhilesh secures the Naagmani. Shivangi's attack ends with her being stabbed. Can Shivangi survive Akhilesh's deadly strike?
Naagmani in hand, Mahesh seeks vengeance at the Raheja mansion. He enlists Yamini's help, discovering hidden serpents. Shivangi's secret waits.
Anxiety drives Shivangi to expose Mahesh's motives. Her Naagmani trade fails, leaving her vulnerable to Mahesh's plan.
Shivangi, driven to desperation, freezes Mahesh after his threats. Her quest for the 'naagmani' fails while Yamini and her allies torture Shivangi's mentor and seize Mahesh's horn.
Disguised as Mahish, Shivangi manages to trick Yamini into trading the 'horn' for a fake 'naagmani'. But all her efforts go in vain when Mahish abducts Rocky and stabs him.
episodes.episodeName: Will Shivangi be able to save Rocky?

episodes.duration: Shivangi must reclaim the naagmani to save Rocky's life. Teaming up with Ruchika, she faces Mahish, who has already stolen their powers. Can they succeed?
Shivangi, as Goddess Durga, defeats Mahish and retrieves the naagmani. Rocky is revived. Avantika discovers Mahish's demise - will she uncover the truth?
Gautami, manipulated by Ruchika, threatens Shivangi's naagmani. Shivangi confronts Manav. Life or death?
Shivangi outsmarts Yamini, forcing her out of the house and removing her protective locket with Rudra's help. Yamini's reign of terror ends with Manav's death.
episodes.episodeName: Shivangi reveals her true self to Yamini

episodes.duration: Shivangi believes Yamini is dead, but she returns, threatening to expose Shivangi's secret. Rudra warns her to be cautious.
Vikram returns with revenge in mind, aiming to expose Shivangi. But will she be able to stop him? Meanwhile, Yamini schemes to steal the naagmani from Shivangi.
episodes.episodeName: Will Shivangi be able to stop Vikram?

episodes.duration: Shivangi's drunken state exposes her vulnerability to Uttara's scheming. But a bigger secret awaits - Niddhi witnesses Shivangi's true naagin form. Will she reveal the truth?
Seeking answers, Rocky confronts Shivangi about the Naagmani. Uttara's death reveals a hidden truth.
episodes.episodeName: Will Rocky find out Shivangi's secret?
Shivangi reveals her true self to Rocky

episodes.duration: Rocky's snake charmers trap Shivangi, Rudra, and Ruchika. Danger looms! Can Shivangi escape the deadly situation?

episodes.episodeName: Will Rudra and Shivangi be successful in their mission?
Shivangi is devastated by Rudra's death
Is Shivangi close to unravelling the secret?

episodes.duration: Shivangi, disguised as the slain Avantika, infiltrates her enemies. Will her cover be exposed? Meanwhile, Ruchika mourns Avantika's death.
Betrayal and murder. Nidhi uses Shivangi, targeting innocent Mansi. Will Shivangi uncover the truth?
episodes.episodeName: Will Shivangi realise that Nidhi is a murderer?

episodes.duration: Naagin Shivangi's secret is out. A deadly confrontation leaves Sushant dead. Gautami uncovers Nidhi's truth. Will she reveal it?
Yamini and Ruchika uncover Shivangi's secret: she's the Naagin. Will Shivangi face their wrath?
To kill Ruchika, Shivangi needs Takshika's head. A temple confrontation ensues. Rocky's arrival jeopardizes her plan.
Shivangi's revenge on Yamini backfires; Rocky's counter-attack looms.
Human Shivangi's powers return in a jailbreak. What triggered her transformation?
Rocky's sudden engagement devastates Shivangi. He casts her out, then divorce follows a protest. Will she fight back?
To save Rocky, Shivangi infiltrates his family, revealing a deadly birthday plot involving his own father.
Rocky's past and a hidden painting reveal truths that shatter Shivangi's reality as Yamini plots anew.
episodes.episodeName: Shivangi uncovers a series of disturbing secrets!

episodes.duration: Birthday party turns deadly. Shivangi discovers Rocky's secret after a ritual, leading to a new mystery.
episodes.episodeName: Shivangi stumbles upon a horrifying truth!

episodes.duration: Rocky's secret identity is endangered. He's losing his memory & killing. Shivangi must help before he's exposed.
episodes.episodeName: Rocky is out for a kill

episodes.duration: Gurudev's warning ignored, Shivangi protects Rocky, battling Yamini's relentless pursuit of his secret.
Takshika's resurrection is short-lived. Rocky transforms. Shivangi's deception protects him. Will Yamini uncover the truth?
Ruchika's back, using deception. Rocky brings her home, upsetting Shivangi. Their deadly feud resumes.
Naagmani seized by Ruchika. Shivangi's power threatened.
Devastated by Shivangi's death, Rocky uncovers Tanya and Jaadunath's Naagmani plot. How will he react?
Ruchika's lies unravel. With Avni's help, can Shivangi defeat her enemy?
Betrayal revealed! Anshuman's expos√© leaves Rocky heartbroken. Will he forgive Shivangi?
episodes.episodeName: Rocky learns the truth about Ruchika and Yamini!

episodes.duration: Revenge is their goal. Shivangi and Rocky's secret alliance battles Yamini and Ruchika.
Manjusha's death unleashes chaos. Ruchika kills Anshuman, jeopardizing Shivangi's revenge. What's her next move?
Ruchika's cruelty claims another life, leaving Shivangi and Rocky heartbroken. Fueled by vengeance, they plan to strike back. Will they succeed?
episodes.episodeName: Shivangi and Rocky out to avenge Avni's death!

episodes.duration: Enemies clash thanks to Shivangi and Rocky's scheme. Tanya dies. What's their next move?
Rocky and Shivangi plot revenge against Ruchika, but a shocking twist unfolds when Rocky proposes marriage. What's his true motive?
episodes.episodeName: Ruchika receives a marriage proposal from Rocky!

episodes.duration: Victory turns to tragedy. Shivangi's triumph is short-lived as Rocky's betrayal leaves her dying.
Vish Khanna infiltrates a wedding to avenge Vikrant's murder. Will the Sehgal family be her victims?
episodes.episodeName: Vish out to avenge Vikrant's death

episodes.duration: On his wedding day, Yuvraj falls prey to Vish's vengeful plot. Lured from his home, he meets a tragic end. How will his family cope with this shocking loss?
Mahir, disguised as Yuvraj, is about to marry Bela. But Bela senses something isn't right. Will she uncover the truth before it's too late?
episodes.episodeName: Bela's wedding turns into a shocker

episodes.duration: Rehaan's rescue mission for Bela turns deadly. She's Ruhi, a vengeful Naagrani, seeking revenge for Vikrant's death. Rehaan is just one of her targets.
Transformation at midnight. Vish protects Bela, but Mahir is coming. Will her secret be revealed?
Rihan's attacker's sandal implicates Bela. Sumitra's investigation tests Vish and Bela's loyalty.
Vish urges Bela to kill Mahir during their temple visit. But as the rituals draw them closer, can she carry out her mission?
Exposed! Bela's list shocks her family. Mahir questions her. Will she survive this?
Bela, unaware of Anu's sinister plan, arrives for a post-marriage ceremony. A trap awaits, designed to expose her true identity. Will she be saved?
Bela's life hangs in the balance as Jamini's sinister plan unfolds. Trapped in an ancient temple, she faces a deadly sacrifice. Can she escape?
Rehan & Bela's closeness fuels Mahir's vengeful wedding scheme. Will Bela expose Jamini's secret?
Jamini, a witch, reveals her secret to Bela, who threatens to expose her. Will Bela succeed in her plan?
Bela battles Jamini's powerful witchery to escape a deadly temple sacrifice. Life or death.
Love blossoms, but danger lurks as Aditya seeks Bela's downfall.
Bela faces a shocking revelation: she's pregnant! But is it true, or a cunning ploy to expose her amidst Nag-Guru's trials for the stolen Nagmani?
Bela's Naagmani quest intensifies. The Naag Guru adds new hurdles: find Mahir's birthmark and inspire his love for her. Can Bela overcome these obstacles?
Torn between love and destiny, Bela sacrifices her heart to infect Mahir. Can she navigate the emotional wreckage and continue her quest for the Naagmani?
Bela's mission succeeds, but a masked thief challenges her. Who is this mysterious adversary?
Vish threatens Bela: kill Mahir or die. Time is running out for Bela and her lover.
To complete her mission, Vish becomes Bela, aiming for Mahir. Bela's interference leaves Mahir questioning reality. Who is the real Bela?
Shock! Vish's engagement to Shaan. Bela investigates. Will she expose Vish's deception?
episodes.episodeName: OMG! Vish and Shaan are engaged?

episodes.duration: Shaan's love for Vish fuels Bela's suspicions. She discovers his snake charming is a cover for evil. Will she stop him?
Bela's enemy, Shahnawaaz, unveils his identity as a snake charmer, claiming her as his bride. Her fate hangs in the balance.
Trapped by Shahnawaaz, Bela's escapes fail. His music controls her. Who will save her?
Mahir finds Bela captive, but his rescue attempt fails. Devastated, he learns she's chosen Shahnawaaz and wants a divorce.
Bela's mistaken confession creates chaos. Her love for Mahir is revealed, but to the wrong person. Can she avoid disaster?
Bela is shocked to discover Yuvraj is actually Vikrant, seeking revenge against Mahir. Can she stop him before it's too late?
Bela, accused of murder, faces betrayal from Mahir and his family. Vish and Vikrant, now revealed, turn on Ajitabh. Will the ACP survive?
Vish seeks the Naagmani, aiming to become Naagrani. Vikrant's plot to kill Mahir and crown Bela threatens her ambition. Will Vish choose power or her sister?
Bela's mother warns her about Vikrant in a dream, but he wakes her before she can reveal his true intentions. Will Bela heed the dream's message?
Betrayal threatens Bela. Nagrani's plan succeeds, but Vikrant and Vish await. Bela dreams of a warning.
Dream clues reveal Bela's true enemy isn't Mahir, but Vikrant. Mahir announces his divorce.
Bela witnesses Mahir kill her mother. Grief-stricken, she vows revenge on Mahir and his family. Will Vikrant's plan finally succeed?
Fueled by grief, Bela vows revenge on Mahir, blaming him for her mother's death. Her promise: Mahir will be dead before sundown.
Vikrant, convinced Bela didn't kill Mahir, suspects her feelings. Determined to make her life miserable, he unleashes his revenge. What will he do?
episodes.episodeName: Vikrant to make Mahir's life hell

episodes.duration: Bela's engagement to Yuvraj ignites Mahir's fury. Will he trust her claim of a clue to Vikrant's motives, or let his emotions cloud his judgment?
Vikrant exploits Bela's vulnerability, aiming to steal a mystical gem. He frames her for murder to achieve his goal. Can Bela escape his trap?
Bela is stunned by Vyom's sudden arrival and his family's strange ways. Suspecting a conspiracy, she wonders if Vikrant is involved. Who is Vyom, and what does he want?
Naag warrior Bela battles Vikrant, only to face a genocidal enemy threatening her entire race. Who is it?
A feather trail exposes Vyom. Bela sets a trap to confirm her suspicions.
Bela, Vish, and Yuvraj team up to expose Vyom and his family's true nature. Their plan intensifies their battle. Will they succeed?
episodes.episodeName: The trio plans to defeat Vyom

episodes.duration: Bela, allied with Vish and Vikrant, seeks to vanquish Vyom. But Vyom plots to reveal Bela's secret to Mahir. Will Mahir learn the truth?
Vyom's plan to defeat Bela using Juhi fails. Now, he deceives Mahir with a fake relationship with Bela. Will Mahir fall for his trick?
Bela wakes from a terrifying nightmare, Vyom's people attacking her. A chilling premonition lingers: is another attack imminent?
Bela eagerly supports Juhi's claim to be the Naagrani, unaware of Juhi's sinister plot with Vyom to kill her. Will Bela discover the truth in time?
Bela crowns Juhi as the Nagaarani to save Vish and Vikrant, vowing to retrieve the Naagmani. Can she overcome the odds and rescue Juhi?
Mahir discovers Bela's betrayal: she murdered his brother Yuvraj and conspired against his family. Enraged, he demands the truth. How will Bela react?
Vish and Vikrant frantically search for Bela, but she's vanished. Mahir seeks help from a kidnapping expert, hoping to find her. Can he succeed?
Mahir learns the truth, but his anger overshadows Bela's plea. Must she reveal all to stay with him?
Bela faces Sumitra, the powerful Naagrani, in a desperate fight for the Naagmani. What's Sumitra's goal?
Naming ceremony stalled. Yuvraj's surprise return with Bela and Vish. Is he alive, or is it Vikrant?
Mahir's room: blood. Bela finds Vish, wrist cut. Murder? Suicide? The truth is hidden.
Love confession, pregnancy claim, and affair reveal. Vish's plan unfolds on JioHotstar.
Bela disrupts Vish and Mahir's wedding. Defying Sumitra, she declares her love for Mahir. Will this bold move sway his heart?
Hostage situation! Sumitra forces Bela to reveal Naagmani's hiding place. Yuvraj aids the capture. Will Bela comply?
Sumitra's betrayal sends Bela tumbling down the hill. Mahir races to save her. Will he reach her in time?
Wedding plans mask Sumitra's blackmail. A watchful stranger unravels her deceit.
Sumitra's plan crumbles when she discovers Bela disguised as Shuli. Furious, she plots revenge, but Bela has Vish and Vikrant to protect her.
Vish's clever move restores Mahir's memories, bringing back Bela. But Sumitra's deadly attack leaves him unconscious. Will Mahir survive?
Bela's desperate struggle: Vish and Mahir are trapped. She secures the Naagmani, but Sumitra closes in. Will Bela sacrifice the gem to save her friends?
Sumitra gloats over her Naagmani, but her triumph crumbles when it's stolen by Vish. Now, the question remains: is Vish alive?
Sumitra doubts Bela's claim of Vish's vengeful spirit. But when she falls prey to Vish's trap, her doubts vanish. Will she survive?
Vish, Bela, and Vikrant's trap claims Sumitra. Lured by the Naagmani, she's trapped, her powers fading. Will they finally win?
episodes.episodeName: Vish, Vikrant and Bela outsmart Sumitra

episodes.duration: To save Mahir, Bela sends him to Naaglok with the Naagmani. Will he remember who he is?
Memory returned, Mahir faces Bela's love and revenge. He must choose: family or his beloved's deadly plan.
episodes.episodeName: Bela confesses her love for Mahir

episodes.duration: Bela retrieves the Naagmani from Naaglok, but danger awaits. Sumitra tortures Mahir for its whereabouts. Can Bela save him?
Grief-stricken Bela is kidnapped after Mahir's incineration. She's questioned about the Naagmani. Escape or death awaits.
Rescued from attack, Bela meets her mysterious savior‚ÄîMahir's twin? No, he's Krish. Bela's disbelief turns to conflict.
Huzoor usurps Bela's Naagrani claim, revealing herself as Ruhi‚Äîa claim mirrored by Bela. The shocking truth unravels.
Huzoor steals throne, Mahir. Devastated, Bela plots her comeback.
Bela challenges Huzoor to a duel to prevent her marriage to Mahir. The Naagin battle begins - who will win?
Juhi, disguised as Mahir, discovers Ruhi's plan to cripple Bela's shapeshifting with a deadly potion. Can Bela outsmart this sinister attack?

episodes.episodeName: Bela to take the ultimate risk

episodes.duration: Hukum's obsession with Bela intensifies.  He captures her, seeking her child.  Can she escape his grasp and find freedom?
Overly friendly Ritvik angers Bela. She suspects Hukum's disguise. His paranormal studies seal her doubt. Will she trust him?
Hukum unmasks his true nature to Bela, but Vish, disguised as her, throws him off. He captures Vish, mistaking her for Bela. Will Bela save Vish?
Vish informs Bela that Sumitra has summoned a doctor to check the authenticity of Bela's pregnancy! With doctor standing at the doorstep, how will Bela get out of the situation?
Vish kills to protect Hukum's child. Bela hides the pregnancy. Truth's revelation shakes Bela.
Hukum's baby is stolen. Bela fights to protect it. A deadly showdown ensues.
episodes.episodeName: Bela's mission to protect Vish's child

episodes.duration: Time is running out for Bela to save Vish's child from the clutches of evil Sumitra, who has disguised herself as Vish and stolen the child.
Sumitra reveals Taamsi Vish's extraordinary daughter. Vikrant's Holi trap targets the menacing Hukum to protect her. Will his plan work?
Evil lingers in Taamsi. A purifying ritual awaits, but her consent is paramount.
Trapped in a burning palace by the vengeful Taamsi, Bela and her companions narrowly escape. Now, they must unravel the demon's plans and find a way to defeat her.
Bela holds Taamsi captive in a magical fire, threatening to destroy her unless she complies. But Taamsi has a secret weapon: Mahir. Will Bela's power be enough to win?
Taamsi holds Mahir captive, demanding the Naagmani from Bela. Bela sacrifices it to save Mahir, but Taamsi has a sinister plan. Can Bela reclaim the Naagmani?
Prophecy fulfilled, Bela & Mahir's rebirth reignites Taamsi's deadly pursuit of the Naagmani. Can they escape?
A chance encounter brings Mihir and Shraanvi, the reincarnations of Mahir and Bela, together. Will their past lives ignite a spark in this unexpected meeting?
Bela's reincarnation, Shravni, fights for Mahir, unaware of his impending marriage.
Bela, with her memory restored, crashes Mahir's engagement. Taamsi, anticipating her arrival, stands ready. Can she stop Bela from breaking the wedding?
Sumitra and Taamsi demand Bela undo the Naagmani curse. Bela refuses, only to find her parents dead. Is Sumitra responsible?
Seeking the Mahanaagarani, Bela learns of Shivangi's fate. She must confront her murderers at the temple to save her.
Naagamani stolen! Despite Shivangi's help and Bela's mercy, Rocky and Ritik win.
Betrayed and imprisoned, Shivangi battles Yamini, now possessing the Naagmani.
Shraavni, Naaglok's protector, battles powerful foes including Shesha. The Naagmani's fate hangs in the balance.
episodes.episodeName: The ultimate war for the Naagmani!

episodes.duration: To marry Keshav, Manyataa abandons her powers. Revenge follows, leaving her child as her only hope. Will they survive?
Naagin Nayantara and her mother plot slow revenge on the Parekhs for Keshav's death. Their first target?
Nayantara's revenge plot against the Parikhs takes a sinister turn. Targeting Dev's grandmother, she aims to expose his hidden serpent identity. Will her scheme succeed?
Twenty-five years of plotting culminates. Mother & daughter Naagins seek vengeance.

episodes.episodeName: Manyata gets access to the Sarpkosh!

episodes.duration: Nayantara's flute compels Brinda to transform into her Naagin form, granting her control.  Will she succeed in leading Brinda to her fiery demise, or will Dev intervene?
Humiliated, Brinda schemes to marry Dev off, hoping to escape the fallout. Will her plan succeed?
Nayantara's secret's out. Manyata needs Brinda's help to protect her daughter from the vengeful Parekhs.
Wronged by Dev's family, Brinda vows revenge after her sister's murder.
A marriage proposal masks revenge. Can Dev & Brinda's families overcome this deception?
episodes.episodeName: Brinda seeks an eye for an eye!

episodes.duration: Nayantara seeks Vish's help to become a Naagin and defeat Brinda. The Naagmani is the key, but can she acquire it?
Faced with ultimate sacrifice, Brinda seeks Manyata. Vishaka's help is a deceptive trap. Will Brinda uncover her betrayal?
Manyata's missing from her Lal Tekdi prison cell. Brinda's vision led her there, but who thwarted her rescue?
Deception and murder fuel Vishaka's quest for the Nagmani. Will Brinda save Dev from her deadly plot?
Truth bombshell: Brinda's pregnancy announcement is upended by Vishaka's shocking gender change and paternity claim.
Naagmani theft leads Brinda to believe Dev is the culprit. Vishaka frames Dev, harming Manyata. Who is Brinda's true enemy?
Vishaka's magic transforms Nayantara into her ally. Brinda's power is their only hope.
Dev's Holi joy shatters as Brinda reveals their marriage, still valid.
Jealous Brinda ousts Nayantara from her bedroom after discovering her helping Dev. Was it a deliberate provocation?
To win Dev, Shalakha tricks him into a honeymoon. Can Brinda stop her?
Naagin Brinda's victory turns sour. Shalakha's revelation traps her. Will Brinda overcome this?
Dev leaves family drama. Brinda's secret may make him stay.
Shalakha's obsession with Dev blinds her to Brinda's love. Using a stolen fragment of Dev's soul, she manipulates him to break up with Brinda. Will Brinda fight back?
A mother's death. A lover's deception. Brinda confronts a shocking truth.
Dev killed Brinda's mother and plans to leave her for Shalaka. Fueled by rage, Brinda vows revenge.  Her plan unfolds now.
A Naagin's wrath descends on a wedding. Dev defends his family against Brinda's deadly quest for revenge.
Dev's life hangs in the balance. Brinda's desperate trip to a temple turns deadly. Unexpected allies arrive to save them all.
Shiva's gift lets Naags fight off Cheels. Aakesh, undeterred, plans a larger attack for the Naagmani.
Aakesh's betrayal incurs Shiva's curse on Nageshwari. Can she overcome his punishment?
episodes.episodeName: Nageshwari is punished by Lord Shiva!

episodes.duration: Veer's wedding crash sparks a fight. A friend disappears. Bani confronts her past: is Veer her enemy Aakesh?
Justice denied, Bani confronts Veer, promising retribution. His reaction will determine their fate.
Brothers target Noor; Bani fights back. Veer must choose a side before Bani strikes.
Bani helps Jay prepare for his restaurant's grand opening. But Veer and his friends arrive uninvited. Is he there to cause trouble, or is something else brewing?
Seeking answers, Bani and Jay find a temple, hoping to understand their shared visions.
Veer's family: ferocious eagles. Bani and Jay aim for total annihilation, using marriage as a tool. Victory or death?
Bani's revenge kills Veer's brother. Veer's rage leads to a forced marriage. Will Bani submit to his vengeance?
Unconscious Jay is rescued by a peahen-woman from a snake. His disappearance puzzles Bani, struggling in her marriage.
episodes.episodeName: A stranger comes to Jay's rescue!

episodes.duration: 1h 4m
Bani's plan explodes. Mayuri shoots, Jay joins, but Veer's the victim. Jay's motives and Veer's fate revealed.
Jay hides, disguised as Mayuri, at a wedding. Veer reveals his secret. Bani's rescue mission begins.

episodes.episodeName: Will Bani fall into Veer's trap?

episodes.duration: Veer seeks revenge for his brother's death, but Bani's arrival and a shocking revelation about Teer's death force him to reconsider. Will he kill Jay?
Veer's missing! Jay's trick backfires. Aakesh's arrival threatens Bani and the Singhania Mansion.
Jay's murderous intent is revealed to Bani, but just as Aakesh prepares to finish her off, he saves her. What is his true motive?
Imposter Veer's dark power exposes him. Jay, with Mayuri, plots against Bani. Will his trap succeed?
episodes.episodeName: Jay lays a trap for Bani!

episodes.duration: Bani, magically imprisoned by Aakesh, discovers him with a ringless Veer. A shocking accomplice is revealed.
Escaping Shakura's mansion, Bani faces a resurrected Veer and Shakura's wrath. Who will survive?
Bani, under Jay's spell, becomes his puppet. He frames her for Veer's wrath. Will he get away with it?
episodes.episodeName: Jay casts a spell on Bani

episodes.duration: After Jay's plan is set in motion, Veer gets closer and closer to the trap. Will he fall for the trap or will fate intervene and save him?
Revenge consumes Bani after Noor's murder. She targets Monil, the real killer. Will she succeed in her deadly quest?
Bani rescues a captive woman and reveals her to Veer.  Overwhelmed with emotion, Veer is reunited with the mystery woman. Who is she?
Revenge brings Bani's family, unknowingly attracting Shatruji, disguised as Markat. A deadly showdown looms.
Party ambush! Bani confronts Veer's mom, Markat, her sworn enemy. A deadly duel awaits. Will Bani fight?
Hidden from Bani, Markat strikes. A magical cave showdown ensues.
Markat threatens Bani with a Chakravyuh trap. Can she convince Veer and Jay of the danger, especially since they doubt her claims about Chandrakala's true identity?
Markat holds Bani's family hostage, forcing her to sacrifice her life for their safety. Will she surrender to his spell?
Beach bungalow safety is short-lived. Cursed waters, Bani's secret, and family endangerment force a difficult choice.
Stambi claims Meera. Bani and Veer battle a powerful ocean god to save their family.
Veer's sudden rejection leaves Bani devastated. She seeks the truth behind his change, determined to win him back.
Veer's wedding to Chandani stuns Bani. Jay proposes a plan: marry him, make Veer jealous, and stop the wedding. Will Bani agree?
Veer escapes Chandni's magic, but his powers vanish. Will Bani save him?
A threat against Veer arrives in a package. Bani tries to stop him, but his lost memories cloud his judgment.
episodes.episodeName: A mysterious package in the house

episodes.duration: Jay manipulates Veer with a drug-induced plan, aiming to drive a wedge between him and Bani. Will Bani see through Jay's scheme?
Jay holds Bani's Aghori ally captive, threatening his life. Can the Aghori fight back and summon Bani before it's too late?
Veer's memory recovery stalls when Bani falls sick. Jay uses this to kidnap her, disguised as a doctor. Will Bani survive?
Bani shields her home with magic to keep Jai away, but can her power truly protect her family?
Markat's power empowers Jay. A fleeing Bani crashes into Veer. Will she fight Jay?
In 2020, a deadly virus threatens India. Professor seeks help from ancient forces, summoning the Naagin to combat the pandemic. Will she succeed?

episodes.episodeName: Naagin to find the first suspect
Shesh Naagin identifies the first Asur

episodes.duration: Mehek's powers dwindle under the red moon on Maha Shiv Ratri.  Praying to Shiva for strength, can she defeat the asur Lalit?
Lalit learns his true identity as an Asur. Pratha, the Shesh Naagin, vows to kill him to save the nation. Will she follow through before her wedding?
Pratha's face transforms during her wedding, hidden by her veil. Urvashi senses something amiss. Will the marriage proceed?
Rishabh doubts Pratha's motives after she breaks up Ritesh and Rhea. Determined to uncover her true identity, he sets out to unravel the mystery.
Pratha and Mehek discover a mysterious musical box in Lalit's room, sensing an asur connection. Determined to unravel the truth, they embark on a quest to uncover its secrets.
The Asurs unleash Maha Sapera, a master snake charmer who vows to capture Pratha. Can she defeat this formidable foe and survive?
episodes.episodeName: Maha Sapera to kill Shesh Naagin?

episodes.duration: A deadly virus, disguised as Shanglira, threatens India. Can Pratha defeat her doppelganger before the nation succumbs?
Shanglira's betrayal leaves Pratha fatally wounded. Only Shalaka can save her, but can Mehek find her in time?
Forced into the Shesh Naagin, Pratha seeks revenge for her friend Diya's murder. Can she stop Rehan's wedding and claim justice?
Rehan's hunting trip becomes a battleground as Pratha seeks revenge for her friend Diya's death. Will she succeed in killing Rehan?
Pratha discovers the identity of the fifth Asur, Mastermind, believing it to be Karan Mehra. Little does she know, Mastermind is her own father. Will she uncover the truth?
episodes.episodeName: Pratha learns of the fifth Asur

episodes.duration: Sardar tricks Pratha into giving up the Naagmani, replacing it with a fake during her birthday puja. Will she discover his betrayal?
Rishab and Pratha's bond deepens, but Yash reveals a childhood pact: they are destined to marry. Will Pratha choose Yash, breaking her connection with Rishabh?
Yash and Pratha are destined to marry, but Pratha's heart belongs to another. Will Yash sacrifice his love to set her free?
Pratha saves Rishab from a poisoned dart, but Seema's honeymoon plan for them hides a dark secret. As Rishab is attacked, Pratha confronts Seema - is she the Maha Asur?
Pratha discovers old photos of Seema and Rishab, fueling her suspicions.  She plans a birthday surprise for Seema, but it's a trap to expose her secret. What will Pratha do?
episodes.episodeName: Pratha has a surprise for Seema

episodes.duration: Pratha introduces Chanda as Seema's friend to Rishabh, shocking Seema. Why did Seema keep Chanda captive for years? Pratha and Mehek seek answers at the Nagmahal.
Seema's cruel pursuit of the Amrit Kalash, driven by years of tormenting Chanda, is about to collide with Pratha's desperate quest to stop her. Can Pratha find the Kalash in time?
episodes.episodeName: Pratha's quest for the Amrit Kalash

episodes.duration: Rainaksh, the Nevla, invades Pratha's home, his marriage to a manipulated Anya revealed. Can Pratha free Anya from his control?
Seema is enraged: Pratha and Mehek found the Amrit Kalash and captured Rainaksh! But he escapes. Will Pratha keep her promise to protect Chanda?
Pratha kills Rainaksh, saving Chanda, but he's resurrected. Rishabh blames her for protecting Samaira, endangering Rehan's family. Will Pratha expose Rehan's true self?
Pratha exposes Rehan's betrayal to Rishabh, but Rehan manipulates Ambika, leading to Pratha's banishment. Can she clear her name and expose the truth?
Seema's poisoned plot traps Rishabh, demanding the Amrit Kalash for his life. Pratha faces an impossible choice: save her love or the precious artifact.
episodes.episodeName: Pratha is in a deep dilemma

episodes.duration: Patriotic Pratha & Mehek win praise, but face a deadly threat. Seema forces Mehek to reveal Pratha's secret to Rishabh or face dire consequences. Will the truth be revealed?
Pratha chooses to reveal her true self to Rishabh, sacrificing her divine powers. But Ritesh attacks Samaira and Mehek, leaving Pratha powerless. Can she protect them now?
Pratha, accused of murder by Rishabh, faces heartbreak. Discovering her pregnancy, she intends to tell him, only to find him with Mehek. What will Pratha do?
Mehek's betrayal of Pratha mirrors Urvashi's, leading to Pratha's death. Now, Mehek seeks the Sesh Naagin's power. Will she claim it?
episodes.episodeName: Will Mehek become the Sesh Naagin?

episodes.duration: Mehek marks a bittersweet anniversary: one year of marriage with Rishabh, one year since Pratha's passing. A lurking shadow disrupts her joy. Who haunts her?
Pratha reclaims her Shesh Naagin powers after Mehek's refusal. Fueled by vengeance, she vows to destroy her enemies. Will she succeed?
Rishabh throws a party for Rajesh Pratap Singh, hoping to secure a deal. But his plans go awry when Rajesh arrives with his fianc√©, a woman who looks identical to Pratha.
Burning with vengeance, Pratha, disguised as Kiara, targets those who wronged her. Mehek seeks the truth. Who will be Pratha's first victim?
Driven by vengeance, Pratha seeks to eliminate those who wronged her. Teaming up with Rajesh, she aims to expose Mehek's hidden agenda. Will she succeed?
In the jungle, Mehek plots to expose Pratha's secret while setting a wild animal on Rishabh. Can Pratha reveal her true self to save him?
Pratha finds a hidden chamber in Naagmahal. A mysterious figure, a mirror image of Rishabh, watches her from the shadows. Who is this doppelganger?
Arjun Kapoor's question at a premiere sparks Pratha's suspicion of Rishabh's betrayal. Will she reveal her hidden secret?
Rishabh fights for his life after being injured while rescuing Pratha from a serial killer. But will she seek revenge or will her actions reveal a growing attraction?
Rishabh plans to demolish Nagmahal and turn it into a tourist attraction. Pratha vows to save it. Can she stop him before it's gone?
Masquerading as a bride, Pratha plots Rishabh's murder during her fake wedding to Rajesh.  Will her revenge plan succeed?
Pratha's wedding is a facade for revenge, targeting Rishabh.  But love lingers, making her hesitate. Will she overcome her feelings and carry out her deadly plan?
A hidden factory tunnel leads to the border. Mehek plans to use it for drug smuggling.  Will Pratha and Rajesh stop her?
Mehek manipulates Rishabh's will with fake evidence, claiming his fortune. Pratha fights back with a daring plan. Will justice prevail?
Mahek traps Kiara in a room, aiming to hurt her. But Kiara is actually Pratha. Will she escape Mahek's trap?
Mehek unlocks the Laal Manzar, freeing Nashika. Pratha and Sesh Naag's plan goes awry, leading to a confrontation with Nashika. Will Pratha emerge triumphant?
Pratha discovers Mehek and Urvashi's sinister Independence Day plot against India. Determined to protect her country, she races to Kedarnath to stop them. Will she succeed?
Mehek's scheme to split Pratha & Rishabh fails. Rishabh faces terrorists, Pratha battles a yeti. Will they survive?
Devastated by Mehek's death, Pratha transforms, revealing her true nature to Rishabh. Can their love withstand this shocking revelation?
Pratha seeks her daughter, adopted by Professor Jeet, with help from Rajesh's aunt. Can she win back custody?
Pratha rejoices as her daughter stays, but Shakti's marriage proposal sets off alarm bells. Will her intuition save her from his deception?
Pratha reveals her true self to Rishabh, but a shocking revelation about her grandmother's death derails her. Can she find the truth?
episodes.episodeName: Pratha to start a new life

episodes.duration: Pratha celebrates her daughter Anmol's birthday, unaware of her destiny as a Shesh Naagin. Will she defy fate and protect Anmol?
Rudra Raichand, a charismatic news channel owner, is captivated by Prathna. But Anmol believes Rudra is hers alone. Will love conquer all?
Pratha and Rishabh visit Rudra's mother, but a snake charmer's flute distracts Rudra. As Pratha transforms into a Naagin, will her secret be revealed?
Rudra sends Prathna to interview Maha Sapera, but the Sapera imprisons her and transforms her into a Shesh Naagin. Can Prathna escape?
Rudra and Prathna attend a charity event for their project. Anmol, Prathna's rival, arrives with her family, creating a tense encounter. How will Prathna respond?
A charity event turns deadly as an attacker murders the minister. Anmol faces an explosive threat, while Prathna, armed with her powers, races to save her. Can she succeed?
Prathna transforms into a Naagin to save a professor from goons. She has no memory of the incident. Can the professor help her unravel her newfound powers?
Pratha transforms into a Naagin to fight Jungasur, unaware it's her own daughter. Together they defeat the villain. Will Pratha discover the truth?
Manav disappears, leaving Pratha to break off her wedding and bring Prathna home. Meanwhile, Rishabh's curiosity about Naagins leads him to uncover secrets.
Pratha faces a difficult choice: reveal her Shesh Naagin identity to Rishabh or risk Patali and Urvashi's threats. Can she outsmart them?
Pratha's heart swells with emotion as Prathna sacrifices herself for Anmol, revealing her true identity. Will Rudra's doubts about the wedding lead to tragedy?
Rudra confesses his love for Prathna, not Anmol. Rishabh, wanting to protect Anmol, asks them to marry instead. Will Anmol accept this difficult choice?
Devastated by Rudra and Prathna's wedding, Anmol is manipulated by Urvashi to destroy Prathna's happiness. Will she succumb?
Pratha uncovers Prathna's shocking secret: she's a Shesh Naagin. But why marry Rudra? Pratha's suspicions rise, will she uncover the truth in time?
Anmol gives Rudra a spiked drink and attempts to seduce him. Meanwhile, Pratha discloses the truth about the Sarvashresth Naagin to Rishabh. How will Rishabh react?
Driven by revenge, Prathna attacks Rishabh, plunging him into a coma. Now, she targets Rudra. Will Pratha, disguised as Rudra, stop her before it's too late?
Prathna and Pratha defeat Zang, but at a terrible price. Discovering Rudra's parents' secret, Prathna knows Rishabh and Rudra are innocent. Will she confess in time?
Rudra, furious with Prathna, cuts all ties.  Pratha, determined to clear her daughter's name, plots to expose the real culprit. Will she succeed?
Pratha, Prathna, and Ritwick unite against their common foe, Urvashi. Exploiting Siyali's feelings, they try to break Urvashi and Suhasini apart. Will their risky plan backfire?
Prathna lures Ranjit and his family to a hidden cave, where she transforms into Urvashi to seek revenge. Will she succeed in her deadly plan?
Pratha and Prathna seek wisdom from the fiery Thakshak Naag. But his anger threatens their quest. Can they pacify him?
Pratha and Prathna battle Puloma's ancient grudge against Naageshwari. Patali wants Naageshwari's power-filled anklet. Can Prathna protect it?
Anmol dies as Prathna gains immense power. But, overwhelmed, Prathna collapses! Can Pratha revive her before it's too late?
Prathna's destiny as Maha Shesh Naagin is at hand, but a chilling nightmare reveals a deadly consequence for Rudra. Will she sacrifice her transformation for his life?
Devastated by Mahek's betrayal, Prathna vows revenge. Will she rise from the ashes to stop Mahek and claim the nine jewels?
Mehek seeks the nine gems, her quest leading her to Prathna, who has lost her memory and found refuge in the Ahlawat family.  Will their paths collide?
Mehek seeks nine gems from Prathna, enlisting Dhanshika's help. Dhanshika finds Prathna and prepares to act. Can Prathna protect herself?
Mehek, consumed by ambition, plots to discredit Naaglok by killing innocents, seeking power through the nine gems. Will Prathna stop her in time?
Mehek targets Unnati Maidan's Christmas party, aiming to confront Prathna. But Prathna, disguised as Santa, arrives to save the children.
Raghu hides his wealth from Preeti, who despises the rich. When the truth comes out, will their love survive the class divide?
Mehek and Seema suspect Preeti is a Naagin. To prove it, they lure her to a secluded spot at night, surrounded by snake charmers. Will the music reveal her true form?
Prathna's quest for her past is cut short by a sinister abduction. Mehek, driven by greed for nine Naagmanis, seeks Prathna's whereabouts. Will their paths collide?
Grief-stricken Prathna seeks Mahadev's help, then attempts self-immolation. Her ensuing Rudra Tandav threatens the cosmos. Can Shesha save the universe?
Ananya seeks revenge on Raghu, leaving him to a venomous snake. Prathna and Shesha intervene, saving his life. Will Ananya face the consequences?
Seema rescues Mehek and plots to kidnap orphanage children. Prathna and Shesha race to stop them, but Seema demands the nine Manis in exchange. Will Prathna sacrifice everything?
Seema's wrath unleashes the monstrous Kirmira on helpless orphans. Can Prathna stop the chaos and save them?
Prathna's ritual to bless the Naagmanis is disrupted when one is stolen. The Mani helps Vish escape, leading to an alliance with the rejuvenated Mehek. What will their revenge be?
Prathna uncovers Raghu's imposter, but guilt over her past rejection compels her to save him. Can she find him before it's too late?
Shesha lies wounded, the victim of Seema's attack. Can Prathna, with her divine anklet and nine gems, heal her in time?
Prathna, alarmed by Raghu's worsening condition, seeks Takshak Naag's aid. Determined to unravel Shesha's sinister plan, will she find answers?
Mehek and Seema frame Prathna for Vinay's murder, convincing Raghu. Cast out, Prathna fights to prove her innocence. Will Raghu believe her?
Ravi's blunder reveals the Naagmanis' location, sparking a clash between Prathna and Mehek. Will Prathna stop Mehek's plan to sell the treasures abroad?
episodes.episodeName: Mehek tries to sell the Naagmanis

episodes.duration: Pratha confronts the Yeti, thought defeated by her mother. But her fury boils over when she learns Mehek has banished the nine Naagmanis. Can she rescue them before it's too late?
Blessed by Shiva and Vishnu, Raghu and Prathna wed in Naaglok. Takshak foretells a powerful child. What destiny awaits their family?
Naaglok's emissary demands Prathna's answer. Her message is sent. Will Raghu agree with her decision?
A national epidemic fueled by misused Naagin venom alarms Prathna. Seeking guidance from Pratha, she must uncover the culprit and stop the crisis.
Prathna's world shatters as her daughter disappears in the waves. Raghu blames her, but their daughter is alive, rescued by strangers. Can their family heal?
Prashant appeals to Prathna to help the spiritual masters. He reminds her that the nation's protection is her responsibility. Will Prathna accept Prashant's request and help him?
As Raghu and the Nagas celebrate Rang Panchami, Prathna and Prashant race to uncover the truth behind the serpents' mysterious deaths. Who is targeting the Nagas?
Prathna's unexpected reappearance shocks Laddu, Gautam, and Sonia. Five years gone, she begs them to forget her. Will they grant her wish?
Raghu's hatred for Prathna stuns Gautam and Sonia. They plan to reunite them during Laddu's Roka, but will Prathna, urged by Laddu, attend?
A fight with Prathna leaves Meher rushing to save Purvika. But when Prathna hears her cry for help, will she be able to reach her in time?
Raghu blames Purvika for his misfortune, demanding her return. Prathna, vowing protection, defies him, escaping with Purvika, bound by a Nagapaash. Can their family heal?
Naaglok's secrets are endangered as Inspector Ajay questions Raghu about shape-shifting snakes. Prathna fears for the truth, while snake charmers aid the investigation.
Mrignaini's sinister plan involves kidnapping Purvika. Naina, under her control, carries out the abduction. Prathna races against time to rescue Purvika. Will she succeed?
Raghu and Prathna journey to Naaglok, finding Swarna near death. She reveals their other daughter's survival, leaving them to uncover their true foe.

Prathna, with Bela's help, finally sees Patali's face and understands Mehek's plot to marry Raghu to Trisha.
Patali seeks Yamini's aid to attack Naaglok with Mehek. Bela battles to defend Naaglok, but sustains grievous injuries. Will she survive?
Prathna, manipulated by Professor Jeet, uncovers a shocking truth about Mehek. Can she expose Jeet's evil scheme before it's too late?
Time is running out for Prathna and Raghu. They must find a worthy successor to inherit the Naag Mani before their lives are lost.
Mehek's shocking return: alive, but seeking revenge on Raghu. A deadly game unfolds as she plans to burn the house down. Can Prathna save her children?
A mysterious box from the Yamuna River holds a ring that calls to Pragati. When she wears it, visions engulf her. What awaits her?
Enthralled by snake charmers' music, Pragati sees visions of Prathna and Raghu. Led to their tree, will she uncover their identities?
Pragati's family was slaughtered by Mehek and Swarna. Discovering Raghav is Swarna's son, will she extend her vengeance?
Witnessing Raghav's strange behavior and Prathna's connection, Pragati seeks Naagraj Takshak's aid. The shocking truth: Raghav might be Raghu reincarnated. Can she find out?
Mehek's divine sight fails to find Raghav, leaving her with unsettling questions. Meanwhile, Pragati's truth leaves Raghav unconscious. Will Mehek unravel the mystery?
Pragati seeks Raghav's help to beat Mehek, but his true allegiance lies with her rival. Now, Pragati must face this betrayal alone.
Haunted by memories, Raghav learns he's a Nag. As his past unravels, will he embrace his destiny or be consumed by it?
In the sacred year of the 2025 Mahakumbh, danger strikes India. Chosen as the protector, Naagin Anantha's fate will decide everything.
Goons attack Purvi and Anantha, prompting the Naagin to protect them. Later, as the moonlight falls on Purvi, she begins to transform into the Naagin, in pain.
Purvi feels intense itching as her skin peels off during her serpent transformation. Later, Parmeet shows his friends the dragon, claiming it will protect them from the Naagin.
Purvi secretly saves a young boy using her snake powers. Later, she transforms into a Naagin as the snakes come to her aid, leading the battle against the wolf.
Samir catches Ravish with his wife and threatens Parmeet. Later, Ravish admits he loves Anantha, wants to marry her, and claims the baby she carries is his.
Parmeet plots to expose the Maha Naag Rani, while Karan's prank tricks Purvi into confessing her love. Later, Gurinder shocks everyone by accusing Parmeet's family of being spies.
Parmeet accuses Anantha of being the Naagin and demands the Naag Mani. Later, his family brutally kills Gurinder's family, as Anantha reveals to Purvi that she is the true Naagin.
episodes.episodeName: Parmeet's Family Takes a Dark Turn

episodes.duration: Purvi rises from the mud as the Naagin and attacks the men who buried her alive. Later, Airul gives ten days to find the Naagmani, triggering a deadly hunt.
An upset Vikram refuses the engagement with Pinky, leading to a confrontation with Aryaman. Later, Purvi disguises herself as Ahana and enters Parmeet's house as Vikram's lover.
Purvi and Vikram's engagement ceremony begins as they exchange rings. Later, Purvi transforms into the Naagin, stabs and kills Swarna, framing Samir for the crime.
Under a dinner pretext, Aryaman spikes Purvi's drink to uncover her truth. Later, the Naagin attacks Samir as he is released from jail and prepares to return to his country.
As part of the wedding rituals, Ahana and Aryaman walk seven rounds around the yagna and tie the sacred thread. Later, Vikram confronts Aryaman for marrying Ahana in his stead.
As Ahana turns Naagin to protect the diamond, Aryaman witnesses her truth. Torn by love, she spares him and chooses a perilous path to erase his memories forever.
Bharani fumes, recalling how she posed herself as Aryaman and attacked, yet failed to stop the Naagin from loving him. Later, Ahana wipes Aryaman's memory before he can expose her.
After the Puja, Ahana performs the Shiv Tandav, believing Mahadev is guiding her to the Divya Naagin. Later, Vikram entrusts his company shares to Purav and Radhika.
Ahana lashes out at Bharani, accusing her of killing Anantha while disguised as Aryaman. Later, Ahana reminisces about Aryaman and shares her grief with Anantha.
At a party, Aryaman and Vikram's clash turns explosive until Ahana intervenes. Later, she transforms into a Naagin and eliminates Pammi in a shocking act of revenge.
Ahana grows cautious after finding the Mantra book as Chengistan plots against India. Later, Aryaman warns everyone about the threat and decides to inform the militant force.
Amid rising danger, Ahana tries to solve the mystery of her new attacker. After overhearing about the threat to the Amarnath Yatra train, Ahana rushes to their rescue.
episodes.episodeName: Can Ahana Save the Amarnath Yatris?

episodes.duration: Ahana discovers Aryaman’s shocking past and makes a heartbreaking choice. Later, she and Bharani infiltrate a high-security centre to uncover the enemy's plan.
Ahana discovers Aryaman's family's killers, who plan to destroy India. Later, she cleverly infiltrates Erul's base amidst creature attacks, escaping only to uncover a new enemy.
Ahana discovers Radhika's secret and her lingering love for Aryaman. Tension heightens when Radhika gets attacked by a mysterious dragon. Who'll step in to save her?
Ahana secretly saves Tina from Dimple’s murder attempt and prepares to take revenge on the family. Later, Aryaman rejects Radhika, as he realises his love for Ahana.
Ahana forces a terrified Dimple to do the same manual labour she once mocked. Using her Naagin powers, Ahana crushes her under stones, taking revenge.
After snatching the Dragon Pearl during the battle to save the Ramos launch, Ahana realises it can remove the dragon’s illusion and reveal its true human identity.
Pinky's wedding turns tragic when Yaman is found dead, raising Ahana's suspicions. Radhika awakens as the ultimate dragon, hinting at an epic Naagin–Dragon battle ahead.
As power and betrayal collide, Radhika secretly weaves a dangerous plan to bring Ahana down. While Ahana senses something amiss, hidden motives and dark forces begin to surface.
Ahana fights off goons to save Tina, foiling Parmeet's plan. A shocking twist unfolds as Radhika reveals how Basha and the scientists tested on her to awaken the ultimate dragon.
A tiger sent by Radhika confronts Ahana, who transforms into a naagin, sparking a fierce battle. Soon after, Ahana is heartbroken as Aryaman hands her their signed divorce papers.
Shattered by Aryaman's betrayal, Ahana's pain turns into fierce rage as she embraces her Naagin powers. As Radhika tightens her grip and dark forces rise, Ahana vows revenge.
As Ahana prepares to marry Vikram and Radhika weds Aryaman, the wedding turns dramatic when Erul storms in. Chaos erupts as hidden motives surface and loyalties are tested.
Ahana reclaims her identity as the Anant-kul Naagrani and the Nagmani. However, her in-laws frame her for murder while the secretive Radhika begins targeting her.
Ahana vows to expose the people who framed her for murder and reclaim the Nagmani at any cost. Meanwhile, Radhika secretly manipulates the family against Ahana.
Apara's mysterious lunar pain uncovers her connection to Ahana and the Naagin bloodline. Aryamaan's vengeance grows, threatening destinies and sparking a war of serpents.
After an attack on an Amarnath-bound train, Radhika saves Apara. She manipulates Aaryaman and Apara's family into a business merger and to unlock the hidden gates of Gupta Mandir.
Radhika uses enchanted water and the Nagmani to compel the amnesic Apara to reveal the hidden Gupta Mandir, but a fierce supernatural clash allows Bharni and Pratham to rescue her.
Following a secret wedding and a lion attack, Apara remembers her life as Ahana. The Suri family's true identity as the cursed Anant Kul is finally brought to light.
Apara adopts a bold persona to provoke Radhika and locate the missing Nagmani. Meanwhile, Pratham uncovers that Radhika is the ruthless Pasha leading a plot against India.
episodes.episodeName: Apara's Bold Plan to Find Nagmani

episodes.duration: Naagrani Apara and her allies rescue Bharni and Tina from Karan. As Tina orders Karan's execution, Apara exacts her brutal revenge, proclaiming her ultimate return!
As Apara discovers her arch-rival Radhika's identity, she tactfully exposes her Changisthani plot to Aryamaan by framing Arjun. This sparks an intense game of deception!
Driven by revenge and destiny, a powerful serpent queen embarks on a perilous quest to uncover her past. Along the way, she battles a global conspiracy threatening the sacred Naagmani.
The serpent queen now hides her true identity to avenge her loved ones. She must defeat the shape-shifting dragon, Radhika, before the sacred Naagmani falls into evil hands.
Naagrani Ananta breaks her sacred ritual to save Aaryaman from Vishaka's venom. She puts the future of the Naagvansh at risk as the rival clan edges closer to completing its tap.
Radhika sacrifices her life to save Pragati and Ahana, clearing the shadows of her past. As Ahana is crowned Naagrani and Vishaka is defeated, the deadly dragon Bahumat awakens.
